newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-SUPERSPORT SERIES CLOSE OF PLAY SCORES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SUPERSPORT SERIES CLOSE OF PLAY SCORES.

text.p: Close of play scores in the Supersport Series matches on Friday.

In Cape Town (day one): Border 210 (M.Boucher 71), Western Province 87-6 (M.Ntini 4-26)
In Johannesburg (day one): Transvaal 302-8 (D.Laing 128, A,Hall 60) v Eastern Province
